label: BL
reason: Alert 1 (insecure-randomness): Using java.util.Random for session token generation is a known security anti-pattern per OWASP guidelines; however, this is part of the OWASP Benchmark which intentionally demonstrates weaknesses. Alert 2 (XSS): False positive - tracing data flow shows cookie.name derives from class name (server-side constant) and cookie.value comes from Random.nextInt(), neither is user-controlled. No user input reaches the XSS sink expression.

evidence.note: cookieName built from class name (server constant), rememberMeKey from Random.nextInt() - no user input
java.util.Random used for session token - insecure randomness source
